title: Fem Technology Absolutely Feature Complete
description: Close every documented v0/v1/v2 deferral in the FEM technology (fem/core, fem/2d, fem/3d, fem-plugin) so it is absolutely feature complete, mirroring the NORM-TECHNOLOGY-ABSOLUTELY-FEATURE-COMPLETE workflow: nodal-averaged cross-element stress smoothing, mass()/geometric_stiffness()/equivalent_nodal_loads() for all elements (Tri3Cst, Tri6Lst, Quad4, Quad8, Tet4, Hex8, PlateDkt, ShellFacet3, Bar2, Bar3), fem_3d solid/continuum regions (FemSolid schema, ops, mesh preview, area pressure loads) mirroring fem_2d's regions, plugin polish (2D reaction labels, 3D oriented member prisms, 3D solid rendering + stress contours, 3D captions), a small framework/renderer/react vertex-color passthrough fix, and nx/project.json/script.ts/launch.json tooling for fem/core/rs and fem/plugin/rs which currently have none. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/make-fem-aboslutely-feature-cached-crane.md.
summary:
Closed every documented v0/v1/v2 deferral in the FEM technology, mirroring the NORM absolutely-feature-complete workflow. Verified 172/172 tests passing across fem_core (92) + fem_2d (31) + fem_3d (29) + fem-plugin (20), zero compiler warnings, both fem_2d/fem_3d wasm32-wasip2 release builds succeeding, fem-plugin's wasm32-unknown-unknown build succeeding, and framework-renderer-react's 170 tests passing with no regressions.

**fem_core** — every Element implementation is now real, no default-None stub where physics is meaningful:
- Added `mass()` (consistent or lumped, each documented) to Tri3Cst, Tri6Lst, Quad4, Quad8, Tet4, Hex8, PlateDkt (lumped), ShellFacet3 (lumped) — closes the self-weight/modal gap for every continuum/plate/shell element.
- Added `geometric_stiffness()` (initial-stress `Kg=∫Gᵀ(σ⊗I)G`) to Bar2/Bar3 (truss transverse `N/L·(I−ccᵀ)`), Tri3Cst/Tri6Lst/Quad4/Quad8 (shared `plane_geometric_stiffness`), Tet4/Hex8 (3D analogue), and ShellFacet3 (membrane-force/out-of-plane coupling) — `PlateDkt` stays documented `None` (no membrane state to destabilize).
- Added `equivalent_nodal_loads()` to Bar2/Bar3 (`wL/2` split); documented the continuum/plate/shell `None` decision on the `Element` trait itself.
- New `analyses::nodal_averaged_scalar` + `StressScalar` — nodal-averaged contour recovery (previously "follow-up workstream").
- New `mesh::boundary_faces` — outward-wound outer-surface triangulation of a tet `VolumeMesh`, feeding 3D solid rendering.
- 20 new tests: mass row-sums, Kg symmetry/rigid-body/sign-correctness, nodal-averaging patch tests, Tet4 self-weight equilibrium, shell tension/compression Kg sign test, boundary-faces area check.

**fem_2d** — density now plumbed into `Tri3Cst` (region self-weight works natively through `fem2d_solve_all`); `RegionMesh` gained `node_ids`; new `fem2d_nodal_von_mises` bridge.

**fem_3d** — full continuum/solid support, closing the "3D continuum explicitly scoped out" gap: new `FemSolid` (footprint + extrusion + tet-splitting via `fem_core::mesh`), `FemMaterial.nu`, a `FemLoad` tagged enum (Nodal/MemberUdl/Area) replacing the old nodal-only `FemLoadCase`, `SetSolid`/`RemoveSolid` ops with true inverses, `fem3d_mesh_preview`, `fem3d_nodal_von_mises`; member UDLs on 3D frames now reachable through the document layer. Example fixture gained a meshed slab solid + pressure load case.

**fem-plugin** — 2D: reaction-value text labels at every support; flat per-element contour fill replaced with a proper marching-triangle (Sutherland-Hodgman clip) nodal-averaged banded contour. 3D: sphere-chain member markers replaced with oriented box prisms (quaternion align-to-direction + Frame roll composition); meshed solids now render as real surface geometry with vertex-color von Mises contours; static/modal/buckling results get an in-scene caption via `ui_stack_vertical` (no framework schema change needed).

**framework/renderer/react** — `WorldMeshData` gained optional `colors`; `geometryFromMesh` sets a Three.js color BufferAttribute when present; `PaintTexturedMesh` gates `vertexColors`/white base color on that attribute's presence (native wgpu renderer stays instance-colored, documented as a known limitation).

**Tooling** — new `fem/core/rs/{project.json,script.ts}` and `fem/plugin/rs/{project.json,script.ts}` (mirroring `fem/2d/rs`, 4 test tiers, no wasm target) so both crates' tests are finally reachable via nx; new `.vscode/launch.json` `🧪test🏗️fem` entry.

Files touched: fem/core/rs/lib.rs, fem/core/rs/project.json (new), fem/core/rs/script.ts (new), fem/2d/rs/lib.rs, fem/3d/rs/lib.rs, fem/3d/example/default.fem3d.json, fem/plugin/rs/lib.rs, fem/plugin/rs/project.json (new), fem/plugin/rs/script.ts (new), framework/renderer/react/index.tsx, .vscode/launch.json, .repo/🎫/26/07/19/FEM-TECHNOLOGY-ABSOLUTELY-FEATURE-COMPLETE/part-checklist.md.
